title: Launch & Future-Proofing — Pitching, Compensation & Operational Excellence
tagline: The migration from protected waters to the open, competitive ocean.
summary: The final transition from learner to market-active entrepreneur focuses on the total compensation of the business and operational excellence through Reef-Native (Edge-Native) standards.

learningObjectives.statement: Evaluate a compensation package beyond base pay and construct a justified counter using 2026 salary-guide data.
Apply the Reef-Native operational philosophy by specifying browser-native, performance-budgeted, offline-first design choices for a product.
Create and deliver a final pitch, refining it against AI feedback on listenability, hesitation words, pace, and eye contact.

activities.title: Total package: bonuses, flexibility, development, review timelines
Browser-native tools, performance budgets, offline-first resilience
Score a product against the Reef-Native checklist
Iterate on AI feedback: hesitation words, pace, eye contact

assessments.method: Submit a data-backed counter-offer with cited salary-guide figures
assessments.successCriteria: Counter cites at least one 2026 data point and names two non-salary levers.

assessments.method: Reef-Native audit of a chosen product with scored checklist
assessments.successCriteria: Audit addresses browser-native delivery, a performance budget, and an offline-first choice.

assessments.method: Final recorded pitch with an iteration log of AI feedback applied
assessments.successCriteria: Capstone pitch delivered; log shows at least two feedback-driven revisions.
